description: Read-only contract call on Scroll (eth_call): send ABI-encoded calldata to a contract at the latest block and get the raw return data, without a transaction or gas. Use to read any view function that has no dedicated tool (the example reads USDC totalSupply, selector 0x18160ddd); decode the result with the function's ABI. Calldata up to 8 KB; a call that reverts is 422 with the reason, uncharged. Example: to=0x06eFdBFf2a14a7c8E15944D1F4A48F9F95F663A4, data=0x18160ddd. Price $0.003/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

from.description: Optional 0x sender address for calls that check msg.sender
